missing_hlg_evaluation.rationale: Voting result 3/3 for NO_MISSING_HIGH_LEVEL_GOALS. The current High-Level Goals comprehensively cover all explicit functional requirements and actor responsibilities documented in the project description. 1) Supplier proposal submission and management is covered by 'Manage Product Proposals'. 2) Administrator evaluation of proposals is covered by 'Effectively evaluate supplier proposals', and system configuration is covered by 'Maintain optimal system configuration'. 3) Warehouse staff responsibilities (verifying incoming goods, monitoring inventory, managing replenishment) are fully entailed by 'Manage Warehouse Inventory', which explicitly includes verification, monitoring, and replenishment handling. 4) Customer online purchasing and payment is covered by 'Complete the online product purchase process', and delivery tracking is covered by 'Accurately track order deliveries'. 5) Customer support ticket management, including assignment and deadlines, is covered by 'Manage Customer Support Tickets'. 6) Manager analysis of business data is covered by 'Make informed strategic decisions'. 7) Store clerk in-store purchase processing and payments are covered by 'Process End-to-End In-Store Customer Purchases'. The retired HLGs (e.g., 'Accurately verify incoming goods', 'Ensure timely stock replenishment', 'Securely complete payments') represent narrower sub-goals or variants that are semantically entailed by the broader current HLGs ('Manage Warehouse Inventory', 'Complete the online product purchase process'). No distinct, uncovered actor-level outcomes remain.
